One complete constrained phase-coordination formulation, zero physics.

nondecreasing phase variables (descent and orientation) while enforcing nominal
peak knee and both foot poses. No extra angle or feedback authority.

revision.construction: Retain330 records through nominal swing knee peak. Subsequent swing knots minimize squared departure of descent/orientation progress from330 subject to bothfeet+COM+nominalpeak-knee equalities and unchangedjointbounds. Descent>=max(previous,old); orientation>=previous, both<=1. The full approach maps both resulting progress values to1; finalapproach/load exact330. This is one constrained construction, not a pose/gain/arm/rate sweep.
